title: SEG Excuses Edge
description: Schema for an Excuses edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: Waiver → TestOutcome. The only downward edge in the graph — all other edges point upward toward claims. Created exclusively by the Functional Safety Manager via the graph manipulator tool. Sink edge: no suspicion propagation, no edgeHash, no linkState. The Waiver node is terminal — it either excuses the outcome or it does not. Approver identity and approval timestamp are derived from git log in repo G at proof generation time.

seg:from.description: IRI of the Waiver node — the one that excuses.

seg:to.description: IRI of the TestOutcome node being excused. Must have outcome FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED — excusing a PASS outcome is a schema-level warning and a graph-level error.
